content: विचल् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To shake, tremble, move; पतति पतत्रे विचलति पत्रे शङ्कितभवदुपयानम् <ls>Gīt. 5</ls>. .²2 To go, proceed, set out. .²3 To be agitated or disturbed, be rough; (as the sea); व्यचालीदम्भसां पतिः <ls>Bk. 15. 70</ls>. .²4 To deviate, swerve; नादण्ड्यो नाम राज्ञोऽस्ति धर्माद्विचलितः स्वकात् <ls>Y. 1. 358</ls>. .²5 To fall off or down. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To shake, move, wave. .²2 To cause to swerve, lead away from. .²3 To excite, agitate, stir up. .²4 To destroy, rescind, annul. .²5 To transgress, violate; अनिष्टं चाप्यनिष्टेषु तं धर्मं न विचालयेत् <ls>Ms. 7. 13</ls>.
